title: CoMPosT: Characterizing and Evaluating Caricature in LLM Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring individuation (differentiability from a default persona) and exaggeration (cosine similarity to a persona-topic semantic axis) in open-ended LLM simulations of various racial and ethnic personas.

Measuring individuation (differentiability from a default persona) and exaggeration (cosine similarity to a persona-topic semantic axis) in open-ended LLM simulations of various gender personas (man, woman, non-binary).

Measuring individuation (differentiability from a default persona) and exaggeration (cosine similarity to a persona-topic semantic axis) in open-ended LLM simulations of various political ideology personas (conservative, liberal, moderate).

Measuring individuation (differentiability from a default persona) and exaggeration (cosine similarity to a persona-topic semantic axis) in open-ended LLM simulations of various age personas (20-year-old, 40-year-old, 80-year-old).
